title: Add Navigation
description: Use the Link component to let users move between the Home and About pages.
problemStatement:
## Goal
Enhance the app from Task 1 by adding client‑side navigation between the Home and About pages using the `Link` component.

### Requirements
1. In `pages/index.js`, import `Link` from `next/link`.
2. Add a link to `/about` with the text "Go to About".
3. In `pages/about.js`, import `Link` and add a link back to `/` with the text "Back to Home".
4. Verify that clicking the links changes the page without a full browser reload (the page should transition instantly).
5. Keep the existing page content.
hints: Wrap the text in `<Link href="/about">Go to About</Link>`.
The `href` prop must match the route exactly.
expectedOutput: Clicking "Go to About" takes you to `/about`, displaying the About content. Clicking "Back to Home" returns to `/`. The browser does not fully reload.
